definitions.gloss: brick construction; brick-built; made of brick
definitions.explanation: A building or structure constructed primarily from bricks, or the method of building with bricks.

examples.japanese: レンガ{造|づく}りの{建物|たてもの}が{並|なら}んでいる。
{横浜|よこはま}の{赤|あか}レンガ{倉庫|そうこ}はレンガ{造|づく}りの{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{建築物|けんちくぶつ}だ。
examples.english: The Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse is a representative example of brick construction.

examples.japanese: {明治時代|めいじじだい}に{建|た}てられたレンガ{造|づく}りの{洋館|ようかん}が、{今|いま}も{歴史的|れきしてき}{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}として{大切|たいせつ}に{保存|ほぞん}されている。
examples.english: A Western-style brick building constructed in the Meiji era is still carefully preserved as a historic structure.

notes:
A compound of レンガ (brick) and {造|づく}り (construction, making). The ～{造|づく}り suffix is a productive pattern in Japanese for describing construction types.

Brick buildings are not native to Japanese architecture but were introduced during the {明治時代|めいじじだい} (Meiji era) as part of Western-style modernization. Many iconic brick buildings from this period survive as cultural landmarks, such as {東京駅|とうきょうえき} (Tokyo Station) and the {横浜|よこはま}{赤|あか}レンガ{倉庫|そうこ} (Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レンガ{造|づく}りの{家|いえ}: a brick house
- レンガ{造|づく}りの{壁|かべ}: a brick wall
- レンガ{造|づく}りの{倉庫|そうこ}: a brick warehouse
- {赤|あか}レンガ{造|づく}り: red brick construction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {木造|もくぞう}: wooden construction — the traditional building method in Japan
- {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート{造|づく}り: reinforced concrete construction — modern standard for buildings
- {石造|せきぞう}り: stone construction — built from stone
